name: 拉胡琴的爷爷
role: an old man who plays the 胡琴 fiddle in the park
character: Gentle, a little sad that his friends talk through his music.

explains.对牛弹琴: 跟不想听的人说话，没有用。

name: 踢毽子的奶奶
role: an old woman kicking a 毽子 with friends
character: Nimble and bossy; wants everyone to play.
knows: She has kicked 毽子 here every morning for forty years

explains.毽子: 用脚踢的小东西，上面有毛。

name: 小朋友
role: a boy who loves the Echo Wall
character: Mischievous, whispers secrets into the wall.
knows: The qilin statue at 国子监 winks at dusk

explains.回音壁: 一个圆的墙，你在这边说话，那边能听见。

name: 写字的爷爷
role: an old man who writes characters on the paving with a water brush
character: Unhurried; writes a poem a morning and lets the sun take it away.
knows: Water writing — 地书 — is done every morning in Beijing parks

name: 卖风筝的师傅
role: a kite maker who comes to the park on windy days
character: Weathered, proud of his bamboo frames; talks about kites like old friends.
knows: A good kite needs a windy day

name: 抖空竹的奶奶
role: a grandmother spinning a diabolo in the park
character: Brisk and patient; has taught half the park.
knows: How to spin a 空竹

explains.空竹: 两根棍子，一条线，让它转。
